hvo_klein_linear.locator: PDF page 19 (HYPOINVERSE section): crustal model specified by four depth points
hvo_klein_linear.reference: HVO operational HYPOINVERSE model (Klein linear-gradient model family; Klein 1981 BSSA 71, 1503-1510; used by HVO and by Matoza et al. 2021)
hvo_klein_linear.role: Association and absolute location for the 2018 Kilauea summit case
hvo_klein_linear.derivation: Transcribed verbatim: Vp 1.9 / 6.5 / 6.9 / 8.3 km/s at 0 / 4.6 / 15.0 / >=16.5 km, linear interpolation between points, homogeneous half-space below 16.5 km.
hvo_klein_linear.vs_provenance: Vp/1.78, the moderate source-region Vp/Vs used by Shelly & Thelen (2019) for this sequence (the HVO model tabulates P only).
hvo_klein_linear.depth_reference: Not stated in the source; HVO catalog depths have a mixed datum history (see Matoza et al. 2025 commentary). Taken below the mean station surface.

layer_semantics.published_representation: Velocity points with LINEAR interpolation between them (not constant layers).
layer_semantics.grid_use: Use velocity_layering: linear (the stage 03/04 ramp between rows is this model's native definition).
